method: Manual review of every card reached by the selected high-reuse families; unrelated audit signals were excluded.

roots.reason: 刀 ordinarily means knife or saber and depicts a knife; sword incorrectly teaches the graph as 劍/剑.
Crustacean replaces the unnatural taxonomic fragment the Crustacea.
Pray and curse removes a malformed infinitive while preserving the ancient ritual sense.
Door bolt is concise and avoids embedding the article the inside every equation and sentence.
Door bolt is concise and avoids embedding the article the inside every equation and sentence.
Air is the common modern meaning of 气 and the concrete image reused throughout its component family; steam is an older, narrower sense.
Household is the useful modern lexical meaning, while the graph depicts a one-leaf door and functions far more clearly as door in descendants.
In difficulty retains the meaning while removing erroneous title casing.
Inflammation remains a useful lexical target, but two fires make flames the concrete reusable image in descendants.
Sharp replaces the malformed target Sharp-Pointed Sharp while preserving the character's core cutting sense.
Cause preserves the central source/reason sense without teaching the obsolete English word wherefore.
Temple is the ordinary meaning of the simplified character 庙; imperial was an adjective fragment.
Reach or arrive is the graph's concrete core meaning and yields clearer descendant mnemonics than the grammatical word until.
Life-giving influence aligns the traditional form with 氲 and fixes inconsistent hyphenation and number.
Window restores the actual lexical meaning that had been truncated to the unrelated word lead.
Thread aligns 紬 with its simplified variant 䌷 and removes erroneous title casing.
Bow of a boat is concise natural English for the same nautical sense.
Name of an immortal restores the local dictionary definition in place of an unrelated fragment.
Ancient animal expresses the same rare sense in clear modern English.
The graph is an animal pictograph and heads a beast radical family; beast explains its descendants far better than worm-like invertebrate.
